protocol.editorMode: product unity.start GUI; one workspace and Editor at a time
protocol.completion: explicit workspace.discard including normal owned Editor stop; library.restore
protocol.work: one real C# expression change, explicit refresh, compiled value/generation/MVID proof; selected model/texture/scene inspection and render
protocol.input: All 1602 tracked source and 42038 Library files byte-equal before each run; untouched original Library restored by product after each run. Baseline Library also starts with the same timestamps/attributes; no reset inside timing.
protocol.setup: Dedicated clone and Library backup copy only prepare the experiment outside product timing. Product itself uses no full source/Library copy. Prior source/server/debugger attempt untouched.
protocol.runtime: be761bb archive baseline vs frozen current Library-only optimization, rejected journal prototype excluded
protocol.accounting: Continuous library.prepare through library.restore; tiny captured-manifest equality check excluded and separately timed. Full input/closure hash proofs outside interval. Per-stage monotonic clocks; same lightweight 2-second built-in-provider-state sampling.
limits: discard branch only; original apply not measured
no general-tool or whole-system RAM qualification
protocol.failure: Preserve exact failed task/intent and evidence; do not rerun writes or force stop automatically. Stop measured series on mismatch.

amendment.reason: Input preparation correction before measured series: full source and Library bytes plus per-file mtimes fixed. No performance-driven selection among matched trials.

commonFix.before: be761bb plus identical bounded-discard routing fix
commonFix.after: Library worker optimization plus same bounded-discard routing fix
commonFix.failure: Default bounded journal was routed to append reclamation and its guard file was rejected. Existing bounded inventory/namespace/fence recovery is now selected; no guard removal bypass.

metricInterpretation: Provider counters are cumulative sampled observations, up to reporting/poll lag; lock/mutation waits aggregate overlapping threads and are not additive wall time. Initial refresh/script compilation/domain reload nest within editorReady, not extra stages. The exit milestone is included in discard. Input proof and experiment setup are excluded.
limits: Two matched observations per version, warm OS caches and one machine
Both versions include identical required bounded-discard correctness repair
Real assets with one C# expression change and selected scene/render validation; not long tasks or universal multiplier
Explicit discard only; original integration not timed
No Play/Test/build, cold-storage, peak physical storage/RAM or general tool qualification
